REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

Individual Consultant Selection

Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS)

Reference No.: ET-ESS-574157-CS-INDV

Hiring of Procurement Specialist

The Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS) intends to recruit a Procurement Specialist under the Modernizing Ethiopia's Statistical System Project (MESSP), financed by the World Bank.

The Procurement Specialist will be responsible for the overall management of project procurement activities in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers, including procurement planning, implementation, supervision of procurement operations, contract management, procurement reporting, and compliance monitoring.

Duty Station: ESS Headquarters, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

Reporting: The Procurement Specialist will report directly to the Project Manager and will also be responsible for supervising ESS procurement staff assigned to support the Project Implementation Unit (PIU).

Contract Duration: Full-time assignment for a period of five (5) years, subject to satisfactory performance and project requirements.

Minimum Qualification Requirements

Interested candidates should possess:

  • Advanced degree (Master's preferred) in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Law, Economics, Project Management, Engineering, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of relevant procurement experience for candidates with a Master's degree, or ten (10) years for candidates with a Bachelor's degree, in large public or private organizations or development projects.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of hands-on experience in procurement under World Bank-financed and/or Government of Ethiopia projects.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers and Government of Ethiopia procurement procedures.
  • Proven experience in the use of the World Bank's Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement (STEP) platform, including procurement planning, document management, contract monitoring, and reporting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as procurement-related information systems.
  • Strong technical writing, analytical, communication, and reporting skills in English.

The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) can be obtained from the Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS) upon request.

The consultant will be selected using the Selection of Individual Consultants (INDV) method in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers.

Submission Requirements

Interested candidates shall submit:

  • An Expression of Interest (EOI);
  • Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV);
  • Three professional references; and
  • Supporting academic and professional documents demonstrating relevant qualifications and experience.

Deadline for Submission: 22 October 2026 at 5:30 PM (Ethiopia Time)

Subject Line: Expression of Interest – Procurement Specialist – ET-ESS-574157-CS-INDV

Procurement Contact

Ayalew Dejene
Ethiopian Statistical Service (ESS)
Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
Email: ayalewdejene1@gmail.com

Tel: +251 962331133

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.
